content: Level Two likewise consists of exotericists who have advanced beyond imitation by using rational reflection; the text calls them the philosophers and dialectical theologians of Islam. They agree with level one on the splitting of the moon but do not forbid questioning: they argue that God is a free agent and celestial bodies are sensory bodies that can be split, so the event could occur at a prophet's command as a miracle confirming his prophethood, a retort to deniers. Ibn Turka says God's wisdom has confined them to this level as well.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
